name: 87401 · Farmington, NM
findings: ZIP 87401 (Farmington) has 136 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87401 (Farmington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 87401 (Farmington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
